matchstick.title: V↔X transformation via single stick reposition
matchstick.principle: A V (two diagonal sticks) can become an X (two crossing diagonals) and vice‑versa by moving a single diagonal stick within the same character, changing its value by ±5.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation contains a V or X and the numeric discrepancy is exactly 5 (or –5), try converting V↔X to adjust the value.
matchstick.example: VI → XI by moving a diagonal stick to turn V into X (value +5).

matchstick.title: Check numeric discrepancy to guide stick moves
matchstick.principle: Compute the Arabic values of both sides; the difference tells how much the total must be increased or decreased.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Always before moving any stick, calculate LHS and RHS to know the required adjustment.
matchstick.example: If LHS = 7 and RHS = 12, the discrepancy is 5, so a change of ±5 is needed.

matchstick.title: Preserve equality sign integrity
matchstick.principle: The '=' sign consists of two horizontal sticks; after moving a stick it must still represent a valid equality sign.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Never remove or add sticks to the '=' sign unless you also replace them to keep it as '='.
matchstick.example: Taking a horizontal from '=' would turn it into a minus sign, which is invalid.

matchstick.title: Validate resulting characters after move
matchstick.principle: After relocating a stick, each affected symbol must still be a recognized Roman numeral (I, V, X, L, C, D, M) or a valid operator (+, -, =).
matchstick.when_to_apply: Check every modified character to ensure it matches a legal symbol before accepting the move.
matchstick.example: Removing a diagonal from V leaves an invalid shape, so avoid that.

matchstick.title: Avoid orientation mismatches
matchstick.principle: Sticks retain their orientation; a vertical stick cannot become diagonal, and a diagonal cannot become vertical.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When moving a stick, ensure its orientation matches the target symbol's required orientation.
matchstick.example: A vertical stick cannot be used to form a V, which requires diagonals.

matchstick.title: Operator conversion only when resulting operator is valid
matchstick.principle: Changing an operator is allowed only if the new shape corresponds to a legal operator (+, -, =).
matchstick.when_to_apply: If a stick is moved to or from an operator, verify that the resulting shape is a recognized operator.
matchstick.example: Adding a vertical stick to '-' yields '+', which is valid.

matchstick.title: Recompute numeric values after transformation
matchstick.principle: After any stick relocation, recalculate the Arabic values of all numerals and re‑evaluate the arithmetic equality.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Immediately after each hypothesized move, recompute values to verify correctness.
matchstick.example: After converting V to X, update the numeral's value from 5 to 10.

matchstick.title: Plus‑to‑minus conversion via vertical stick relocation
matchstick.principle: A plus sign consists of one vertical and one horizontal stick; moving the vertical stick away turns it into a minus sign, and vice‑versa.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When adjusting the operator, consider converting '+' to '-' or '-' to '+' by moving a vertical stick.
matchstick.example: Remove the vertical from '+' to obtain '-'.

matchstick.title: Dual‑character stick relocation for balancing values
matchstick.principle: A single stick can be taken from one character (decreasing its value) and attached to another (increasing its value).
matchstick.when_to_apply: If the numeric discrepancy cannot be resolved by a single‑character change, try moving a stick between two characters.
matchstick.example: Take a vertical from an I and add it to a V, turning the V into X (value +5).

matchstick.title: Discrepancy‑5 heuristic for X↔V adjustment
matchstick.principle: If the computed difference between sides is exactly 5 (or –5) and the equation contains an X or V, then adjust by moving a diagonal stick to convert V↔X.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the discrepancy is 5, look for V or X characters to transform.
matchstick.example: Convert V to X to increase the value by 5 and close a 5‑unit gap.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model treats sticks as interchangeable, ignoring that vertical, diagonal, and horizontal sticks have fixed orientations.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Enforce orientation constraints; only move sticks to positions requiring the same orientation.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may try to take a stick from '=' to change other symbols, forgetting that '=' must stay as two horizontals.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Never remove or add sticks to the '=' sign; keep it unchanged.

matchstick.description: Leaving an invalid character after move
matchstick.why_it_happens: After moving a stick, the source or target symbol may no longer match any valid Roman numeral or operator.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Validate each modified character against the set of allowed symbols.

matchstick.description: Changing an operator to an invalid shape
matchstick.why_it_happens: Moving sticks to operators without checking resulting shape may produce non‑operator symbols.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Only convert operators to other valid operators (+, -, =) and verify the shape.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model may try random moves without first computing the needed numeric adjustment.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always compute the Arabic values of both sides first to guide the stick move.
